🧸 Squishy Tower: 250+ Stages
Theme: Everything is made from soft, squishy toys and foods. Each world has a different squishy style with unique obstacles.🟨 World 1 - Butter Land (Stages 1-50)
Butter stick jumps
Melting butter slides
Butter cube maze
Toast platforms
Pancake stack climb
Butter waterfall
🟢 World 2 - NeeDoh World (Stages 51-100)
Giant NeeDoh balls
Stretchy bridges
Squish launch pads
Bubble tunnels
Color-changing platforms
Bounce rooms
🥟 World 3 - Dumpling Village (Stages 101-150)
Steamed dumplings
Chopstick balance beams
Soy sauce lakes
Bamboo steamers
Giant bao jumps
Noodle swings
🍡 World 4 - Mochi & Candy (Stages 151-200)
Mochi trampolines
Jelly cubes
Marshmallow clouds
Gummy bear parkour
Lollipop spinning poles
Cotton candy climb
🌈 World 5 - Ultimate Squishy Factory (Stages 201-250+)
Squishy-making machines
Conveyor belts
Giant presses (safe timing obstacles)
Rainbow slime rivers
Squishy monster boss escape
Neon rainbow finale
⭐ Bonus Stages (251-300)
Impossible Butter Challenge
Invisible Squishies
Tiny Mode
Giant Mode
Speed Run
Low Gravity
Rainbow Tower
Lava Squish
Ice Squish
Secret Developer Room
🎁 Collectibles
🧈 Butter Pets
🟢 NeeDoh Pets
🥟 Dumpling Pets
🍡 Mochi Pets
🧸 Teddy Squishy
🐸 Frog Squishy
🦄 Unicorn Squishy
🐼 Panda Squishy
🏆 Rewards
Checkpoint every 5 stages
Free trails
Squishy-themed badges
Daily spin wheel
Secret hidden rooms
Rebirth system
VIP area with exclusive squishies
This gives you 300 stages total, with plenty of variety so the tower doesn't feel repetitive. You can also add seasonal updates (Halloween, Christmas, Easter, Summer) with new squishy-themed stages and collectibles to keep players coming back.

answers.ask: 300 stages will not fit one image. Do you want the five worlds built as five separate towers stacked in fiction, or one continuous spiral generated in passes?
answers.answer: Build the five worlds as five separate themed towers, progressing in order from Butter Land through the Ultimate Squishy Factory; this keeps each world distinct and manageable.

answers.ask: Is each world its own tower with a teleporter between them, or does one tower run all the way up?
answers.answer: Each world is its own tower, with a teleporter at the completed tower’s top leading to the next world.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] scale — Q: 300 stages will not fit one image. Do you want the five worlds built as five separate towers stacked in fiction, or one continuous spiral generated in passes? A: Build the five worlds as five separate themed towers, progressing in order from Butter Land through the Ultimate Squishy Factory; this keeps each world distinct and manageable.
- [author] shape — Q: Is each world its own tower with a teleporter between them, or does one tower run all the way up? A: Each world is its own tower, with a teleporter at the completed tower’s top leading to the next world.
- [agent_inferred] bonus placement — Q: Where do stages 251–300 go without creating a sixth world? A: Add them as an optional upper bonus annex in the fifth tower after its stage-250 completion.

## Enriched image prompt
Create five separate sequential squishy-themed tower courses totaling exactly 300 stages, with safe checkpoint pads every five stages. Tower 1, Butter Land, contains stages 1–50 with butter-stick jumps, melting slides, a butter-cube maze, toast platforms, pancake climbs, and a butter waterfall. Tower 2 is an original soft stress-ball world for stages 51–100, with giant squishy balls, stretchy bridges, launch pads, bubble tunnels, color-changing platforms, and bounce rooms. Tower 3, Dumpling Village, contains stages 101–150 with steamed dumplings, chopstick beams, soy-sauce lakes, bamboo steamers, bao jumps, and noodle swings. Tower 4, Mochi & Candy, contains stages 151–200 with mochi trampolines, jelly cubes, marshmallow clouds, gummy-creature parkour, spinning lollipop poles, and cotton-candy climbs. Tower 5, Ultimate Squishy Factory, contains stages 201–250 with machines, conveyors, safely timed presses, rainbow-slime rivers, a monster escape, and a neon finale. Its upper annex holds stages 251–300: Impossible Butter, invisible, tiny, giant, speed, low-gravity, rainbow-tower, lava, ice, and secret-developer-room challenges.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Obby & Platformer (`obby-platformer`), specifically a multi-world tower obby.

## Shape and preset
Use `world-chaptered` as the top-level container because the five towers are separate maps linked in order. Each of the five map segments uses `course-tower`, preserving its stacked vertical obstacle route. The matching preset is Tower Obby.

## Config requirements
Use `path-track`, `obstacle-jump`, `obstacle-moving`, `obstacle-timing`, `obstacle-climb`, and `obstacle-maze` for the named stages. Use `hazard-kill` for Lava Squish, `water-body` for soy-sauce lakes and slime rivers, and the drawn forms of `checkpoint-respawn`, `teleporter-link`, and `winner-zone`. Use `alcove-secret`, taken from the shared catalogue, for hidden rooms and the Secret Developer Room, and `gate-progression` for the single VIP squishy area. All named themed props are required.

## Layout requirements
Place exactly 60 `checkpoint-respawn` markers, one after every five stages. Place four cross-map `teleporter-link` pairs between towers 1–5. Place six `winner-zone` markers at stages 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, and 300; stage 250 also opens the same-map bonus annex. Use `collectible-nodes` for eight collectible-pet types: butter, stress-ball, dumpling, mochi, teddy, frog, unicorn, and panda squishies. Use `spawner-npc`, taken from the shared catalogue, for one monster origin in the factory escape.

## Layout components
There are exactly five tower maps, 300 ordered stages, 60 checkpoints, four cross-map teleporter links, six completion areas, one upper bonus annex in tower 5, hidden rooms, and one VIP area. Towers 1–4 contain 50 stages each; tower 5 contains stages 201–250 plus bonus stages 251–300. Each tower has a distinct squishy-food identity and a physics-valid vertical path.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: generate each ordered physics-valid tower route first with linked vertical captures, then apply its themed dressing.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is large per separately rendered tower so individual stages and props remain legible. The theme is colorful soft squishy toys and foods. Use `P6` for valid obstacle routes, `P2` for stacked platforms, `P4` for separate towers, and `CHECK` for soy-sauce and slime water features.
